title: Brownbook global construction and architecture collection
description: Read public Brownbook sitemaps, identify construction and design firms, visit public profiles, and collect real external websites and contacts.

startUrl.title: Brownbook sitemap index URL
startUrl.description: The public Brownbook master sitemap index used to discover business profiles.

targetCountries.title: Target countries or regions
targetCountries.description: Country codes to retain. EU enables supported European Union countries. Common values: US, CA, GB, AU and EU.

constructionKeywords.title: Construction and design keywords
constructionKeywords.description: Keywords used to identify likely construction, architecture, BIM, drafting and rendering profiles from sitemap URLs.

maximumNewCompanies.title: Maximum new companies this run
maximumNewCompanies.description: Stop after this many new, unique companies have been saved during the current run.

maximumProfilesVisited.title: Maximum profiles visited this run
maximumProfilesVisited.description: Maximum number of candidate Brownbook company profiles opened during this run.

maximumSitemapsThisRun.title: Maximum profile sitemaps this run
maximumSitemapsThisRun.description: Maximum number of leaf sitemaps scanned in one run. Each may contain many company URLs.

requireWebsite.title: Require a real company website
requireWebsite.description: Save only companies with a valid external website after excluding social networks and other directories.

collectEmails.title: Collect public profile emails
collectEmails.description: Collect email addresses publicly displayed on Brownbook company profiles.

includeUnknownCountries.title: Include companies with unknown country
includeUnknownCountries.description: Save otherwise valid companies when their country cannot be confidently detected.

scanNewestFirst.title: Scan newest companies first
scanNewestFirst.description: Start with Brownbook's newest sitemap/profile records before older records.

campaignName.title: Campaign name
campaignName.description: Keep this unchanged to continue saved progress and deduplication across runs.

resetProgress.title: Reset saved campaign progress
resetProgress.description: Erase the campaign checkpoint and deduplication history. Enable only on the first run of a new campaign.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum time allowed for each sitemap or company-profile request.

delayMillis.title: Delay between profile requests
delayMillis.description: Polite delay between Brownbook profile requests. Brownbook requests a 10-second delay for general crawlers.
